subject: Catalyst Analytics case study — quotes, assets, and embargo timing
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst case study draft + quote & embargo options

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for agreeing to be a customer spotlight. Attached is our first-pass case study draft (high-level product usage, metrics we captured during the pilot, and a few screenshots). Two asks from our side to keep this moving:

1) Quote: Would you be willing to provide a short 1–2 sentence quote we can use in the press release and on the case study landing page? If easier, we can propose copy for you to approve.
2) Embargo timing: Do you have any embargo/window constraints? We plan to propose a public embargo of 09:00 PT on 2027-06-18 but are flexible if you need a different date/time for your teams or legal.

Also: please confirm whether we can use the Catalyst logo and the 1–2 product screenshots in the case study. If your legal or brand team requires a short review window, we can accommodate — just let us know target dates.

Attachment: catalyst-case-study-draft.docx (document)

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — Making LLM inference predictable and economical

From: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@catalyst.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@catalyst.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalyst case study draft + quote & embargo options

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the draft. Nice work — it captured the pilot results well. Quick responses below: 

Quote: happy to provide a quick quote. Two options from my side (feel free to pick / edit):
- Option A (short): “Redwood’s inference platform cut our median latency in half and let us scale without a spike in GPU spend.”
- Option B (longer): “By migrating key workloads to Redwood Inference and using their curated model profiles, we reduced latency by ~50% while keeping our operational costs flat during a 3x traffic increase.”

Embargo: 48 hours is fine. We prefer a weekday publish — the date you proposed (2027-06-18 at 09:00 PT) works for our press calendar.

Logo/Assets: Legal wants to sign off on our logo usage and two screenshots. I’ve looped legal on this thread (legal@catalyst.ai). They typically need 48–72 hours to review guidelines.

Attachments: I will send final logo files after legal signs off.

Best,
Jordan Evans
Head of Product
Catalyst Analytics
jordan.evans@catalyst.ai

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Catalyst case study draft + quote & embargo options

Marissa / Grace — forwarding Jordan's reply. He provided two quote options (short and long) and confirmed the 2027-06-18 09:00 PT embargo window is acceptable. Legal at Catalyst will want 48–72 hours to review logo/screenshots.

Marissa — can you please: 1) pick or rewrite one concise quote for the release (1–2 sentences) that emphasizes performance and reliability, and 2) paste the final pressline into a tiny text file for our press kit?

Grace — please confirm whether a 48-hour legal review from Jordan is compatible with our internal launch checklist (i.e., can we still hit 06/18 with their review timeline). If not, propose fallback dates.

I’ve attached the draft and added a suggested small edit to the metrics paragraph (minor wording).

Attachment: catalyst-case-study-draft.docx (document)

Thanks — Naomi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Catalyst case study draft + quote & embargo options

Nice — thanks for the ping. My suggested press quote (concise, emphasis on performance + TCO):

“Catalyst Analytics reduced median inference latency by over 50% after switching to Redwood, enabling faster product iterations without increasing inference spend.

I saved the final pressline into a small file for the kit.

Attachment: press-quote-line.txt (text)

Grace — from an ops/launch perspective we need final logo and screenshot assets by EOD 6/16 to meet our normal QA + formatting timeline for the case study and PR syndication. If Catalyst legal can clear by then, we are good for 06/18. If not, we should move to the following Monday (06/21).

Naomi — please push Marissa's line to Jordan for sign-off and confirm the asset deadline with Catalyst legal.

–Marissa
PR Lead 
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, legal@catalyst.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst case study draft + quote & embargo options

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround and the two quote options. Marissa suggested a compact line (below) that we think reads well for the release and matches the tone of other customer quotes:

Catalyst Analytics reduced median inference latency by over 50% after switching to Redwood, enabling faster product iterations without increasing inference spend.

If you’re happy with that, we’ll use it verbatim in the press release and case study. If you prefer one of your original options, tell us which and we will use it instead.

Embargo confirmed: proposed publish target is 09:00 PT on 2027-06-18. Per Marissa, we need final logo + screenshots by EOD 2027-06-16 to keep our formatting/QA schedule. Does that timeline work for Catalyst legal?

I’ve attached an updated case study draft (v2) with Marissa's quote inserted and a one-page logo guideline (format/clear space requirements) to make legal's review easier.

Attachments:
- case-study-draft-v2.docx (document)
- logo-guidelines.pdf (guide)

Thanks — Naomi

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst case study draft + quote & embargo options

Hi Naomi / Marissa / Grace —

All good from our side. We approve the Marissa-suggested wording as the final quote. Embargo at 09:00 PT on 06/18 is fine. Catalyst legal cleared the logo guidelines this morning and I attached the final logo pack.

Attachments: Catalyst-logo.svg (vector), catalyst-logo-zip (contains PNG/JPG/SVG), legal-clearance-note.pdf (document)

Quick note: legal asked that we avoid mentioning exact dollar savings in the public case study (we don't have permissions to disclose unit spend). I reviewed the draft and the only place that could be interpreted that way is the short "cost" sentence — suggest we keep the current wording that mentions spend did not increase rather than a specific number.

Thanks for accommodating our review window — looking forward to the publish.

Best,
Jordan Evans
Head of Product
Catalyst Analytics
